name: chrome_search_wikipedia_article
intent: Search Wikipedia in Chrome for a topic and find the year it opened
description: Opens the mobile Wikipedia site in Chrome, searches for the requested topic, scrolls through the article to find its opening information, and reports the opening year.
patterns: search Wikipedia for something and tell me when it opened
look up a topic on Wikipedia and find its opening year
find when something opened on Wikipedia

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: Topic or article title to search for on Wikipedia

steps.intent: Type en.m.wikipedia.org in the URL bar and submit
Tap Search to open the search field
Type {{topic}} in the search field and submit
Scroll down the article to find the opening information
